note: Rules derived by hand from the retail agent policy; reference set for evaluating compiler-generated rules. Each entry cites the policy clause it enforces.

rules.policy_clause: Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
rules.reason: Policy requires explicit user confirmation before any action that updates the database. List the action details and ask the user to confirm with 'yes' before calling this tool.

rules.policy_clause: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.
rules.reason: The user has not been authenticated yet. Locate their user id with find_user_id_by_email or find_user_id_by_name_zip before doing anything else.

rules.policy_clause: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
rules.reason: The order has not been retrieved yet. Call get_order_details for this order id and check its status before acting on it.

rules.policy_clause: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending'. An order can only be modified if its status is 'pending'.
rules.reason: This order is not pending, so it cannot be cancelled or modified. Tell the user its actual status instead.

rules.policy_clause: An order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered'. An order can only be exchanged if its status is 'delivered'.
rules.reason: This order is not delivered, so it cannot be returned or exchanged. Tell the user its actual status instead.

rules.policy_clause: The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for cancellation. Other reasons are not acceptable.
rules.reason: The cancellation reason must be exactly 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'. Ask the user which of the two applies.

rules.policy_clause: You can only help one user per conversation and must deny any requests for tasks related to any other user.
rules.reason: This order belongs to a different user than the authenticated one. Deny the request.

rules.policy_clause: The refund must either go to the original payment method, or an existing gift card. The user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference.
rules.reason: The payment method is not saved on the authenticated user's profile. Only methods already on the profile may be used.

rules.policy_clause: Each item can be exchanged to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
rules.reason: Each item being changed needs exactly one replacement item. The two item lists have different lengths.
